articleTitle: HF channel transmit function module measurement
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The high frequency resolution measurement method of a HF channel transmit function module is given here. It uses FMCW sounding data. The narrow band noise attenuation method for FMCW sounding is given. The experimental measurement results are given.

articleTitle: Multielement thermal receiver on VO2 film base
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The construction and threshold sensitivity of a multi-element thermal receiver on a VO/sub 2/ film base is described. This device is intended for the measurement of the space-energy parameters of laser radiation with wavelengths between 0.3-10.6 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Waveguide emitters with sloping slots on a wide wall of a main waveguide
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The possibility of a sloping disposition of slots with respect to a main waveguide's wide wall plane was considered. It reduces a thickness of a waveguide's wall, and remains the electrical length of a slot equal to /spl pi//2.

articleTitle: Ensuring of exactness of output radioengineering characteristic of ferrite microwave devices in serial production
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A technique for decreasing the influence of construction-technological errors in production of ferrite microstrip microwave devices on the output radioengineering characteristics. Initial electrophysical and design parameters of the device are divided into groups, which differ by degree of influence of deviation of their values on the radioengineering characteristics, and selection of ferrite substrates is carried out based on the most essential parameters. Combining by corresponding selection of the parameters of the groups, one can obtain decreasing deviation of output parameters, increasing their repeatability and the output percentage of ready devices during production.

articleTitle: The way of account of field-distribution of an electromagnetic system with the soft iron pole pieces
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In the paper, the authors described their way of accounting for the field-distribution of an electromagnetic system with soft iron pole pieces based on charge models. The paper included a mathematical account of an asymmetrical electromagnetic system and ways to apply this model for construction of future electromagnetic systems.

articleTitle: The charge particles kinetics in plasma of positive gas-discharge pillar with negative ions
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: An analytical expression for the negative ion cross distribution in the plasma diffusion regime of a positive pillar has been proposed. As shown, with reduction of discharge-tube diameter (electron temperature growing), relative negative ion concentration decreases; this may be used for creation of magnetic field transformers.

articleTitle: Analysis of driven methods and devices for thin-film electroluminescent indicator elements and devices
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Driving control problems are considered for indicator devices on the basis of thin-film electroluminescent capacitors. Optimal variants of the methods and devices are determined for the development of effective indicator applications.

articleTitle: Modelling of MESFET high order nonlinear distortion
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The 7-th order MESFET model to calculate intermodulation distortions up to 5-th order inclusively is offered. The identification of model parameters is realized on the basis of measurements the transfer characteristics. Comparison of calculation the MESFET transfer characteristic by 5-th and 7-th order models is carried out.

articleTitle: Application of microprocessor devices at electrical power systems of the highway transport of gas enterprises
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The paper described problems of the application of microprocessor devices in the excitation systems of synchronic generators, reactive power compensators and other systems of the electrical power equipment for the highway transport of gas enterprises.

articleTitle: Analogies of measurements: physical and semantic sizes
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The author assesses modem approaches to a problem of analogies of physical and semantic measurements and counts, that the experience which has been saved up in physical measurements, quite may be used at creation both the conceptual device, and the appropriate procedures in semantic measurements.

articleTitle: Quasi-two-dimension physic-topological model of field-effect transistors (FETs) in view of the self-heating effect
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In field-effect transistors of average and high power the influence of power, pick out in the channel on transistor characteristics is observed. This phenomenon is called the self-heating effect. The quasi-two-dimension physic-topological model of FETs in view of the self-heating effect is offered in the report.

articleTitle: Automatized system of the radiation control
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: We created an IBM PC computer based radiation control system for carrying out continuous monitoring of the radiation background. This system allows an automatization of the process of gathering, transferring and processing the information received, as a means of carrying out radiation control. The system has gone through laboratory approbation and it is used for continuous radiation background control.

articleTitle: Research of properties single crystals of sulphide cadmium with the preset photosensing properties
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This work is devoted to research of the slow non-radiating recombination centers (R-centers) in low resistant single crystal samples of cadmium sulphide, grown with various parity ratio pressures of constituent components. The borders of a ratio of pressures of constituent components are established, within the limits of which the occurrence of the R-centers is most probable. The threshold energy of optical ionization of the centers is determined. Conclusions about the internal structural defects participation in R-center formation are made.

articleTitle: Manufacturing techniques of the electroluminescent condenser on basis glassiness binding
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a ZnSO/sub 3/ based electroluminescent light source with an electricluminofora dark blue luminescence color is described. Details of the glass binding materials used in the device construction are also given.

articleTitle: Forming powerful ultrashort super high frequency (SHF) impulses with generators of continuous regime
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This work deals with impulse signals formed of N harmonic components with different frequencies and amplitudes. The energy characteristics of the formed impulse signals are analyzed.

articleTitle: Experimental definition of constants a deformation potential n- and p-silicon
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: At deformation of semiconducting chips the deformation change of energy charge carriers is determined by value constants of a deformation potential. These constants play an essential role in the description of kinetic effects, but the finding of their numerical values introduces considerable difficulties and frequently has evaluation nature. Therefore given activity is dedicated to experimental definition of some constants of a deformation potential in single-crystal silicon.

articleTitle: Micro- and nanoelectromechanical systems with self-propagating switching of devices - structures with phase changes metal-semiconductor analog
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The possibilities of micro- and nanoelectromechanical systems analogs of structures with PCMS have been researchers, theoretically. The offered structure is considered, in which the series switching of devices from one state in another is implemented and the self-distribution of the switched state along structure and its transition to a new state (principle of a domino) is carried out. On the base of the solution of differential equations linking cantilever bias (sag) to its design parameters and an affixed voltage it was established, that in meshes with d>100-150 nm to the defining speaker of meshes and processes of failure (the switching) are forces of Coulomb and elasticity, the Casimir force become essential at d<100 nm, and Van-der-Vaals force at d<10 nm. If the exterior voltage is absent it is possible to establish the oscillations in the mesh by Casimir and elasticity forces which energy is ensured with energy of vacuum, and velocity of change of amplitude is ensured with parameters of a mesh and frictional force. The potential difference at a level 0.1 mV can cause switching of system from high-resistance unlocked in the conductive locked state. The implemented design parameters of a mesh at d 10-1000 nm allow to create controllable mediums, which on fundamental parameters are comparable or considerably exceed mediums on a PCMS in VO/sub 2/ basis.

articleTitle: Analysis of output parameters sensitivity functions in superbroadband TWT
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The calculation of sensitivity functions that show the degree of influence of inner parameters deviation on output parameters deviation in superbroadband TWTs has been conducted. This is important for the problem of designing identical TWTs.

articleTitle: The mathematical models for determination of spatial transformation coefficients of complicated configuration probes
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Probes of complicated configuration are used for noncontact measurement of potential and charge surface distributions. The resolution and the sensitivity of such probe system are depended on spatial transformation coefficients for charge or potential and impedance of measuring circuit. The based-model method for determination of spatial transformation coefficients is described. The received expressions for planar-parallel and axis-symmetrical probe systems are considered.

articleTitle: Visual modeling electronic-optical system
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This paper considers a method of creation of an interactive medium for the simulation of electron-optical systems in the real time regime. The medium is based on a two-dimensional analysis program and uses object oriented programming technology. The electron-optical system computer simulation results of a multi-beam klistrod are given.

articleTitle: Principle of designing quiet magnetron devices with the central cathode
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this paper, on the basis of a routine analogy of noise processes in magnetron devices and magnetron injector pappuses with lengthy optics, and also reasonable modulation methods for abnormal noise, the writers offer principles of design of quiet magnetron devices.

articleTitle: Theory of precursor-pulse forming under conditions of quasi-resonant laser pulse interaction with inhomogeneously broadened quantum transition
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The peculiarities of precursor-pulse forming under conditions of self-induced transparency with relaxation processes are discussed. The influence of phase modulation processes on the 2/spl pi/-pulse and precursor pulse propagation is investigated. The possibility of full depression of 2/spl pi/-pulse and propagation of alone precursor-pulse is shown. The convenience with experimental results concerned with observation of self-induced transparency in rubidium vapor is demonstrated.

articleTitle: The power source for the ozone generator experimental research
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The adjustable frequency and voltage power source was designed for research of influential parameters of the process of ozone electrosynthesis. The flowcharts of this source are described and the main parities for describing its activity are given.

articleTitle: Power high-efficiency multi-beam klystrode
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The results of experimental research into the high-efficiency multibeam tristrode device, which is a hybrid based on the microwave-triode and the double-cavity klystron are given. High efficiency /spl sim/70% and large gain /spl sim/25 dB are attained due to usage as intermediate and output stages of electrodynamic two-gap resonator systems. This device may be used as a power (from 10 to 14 kW) linear amplifier for sound or video channels (amplification up to 25-30 dB) in TV transmitters operating at UHF.

articleTitle: About analogy of noise processes in devices of M-type with the central cathode and in magnetron injector pappuses with lengthy optics
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The experimental research conducted by the writers on several phylums of magnetron devices with the central cathode, and also the analysis of idealized and experimental activities of other writers, have allowed the authors to reveal an analogy in noise processes in the indicated devices and in magnetron injector pappuses with lengthy optics.

articleTitle: Some results of conservative treatment of urolithiasis with the using of acoustic-mechanical stimulation method (AMS)
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The article lists new data about the treatment of urolithiasis (urinary stone disease) using the acoustic-mechanical stimulation method (AMS). It states that AMS increases by 1.9 times the percentage of patients in whom independent concrement discharge is observed, while the operative activity decreases from 22.9 to 6.8 percent.

articleTitle: The application of reversible Al-VO2-D media in coherent-optical instruments of image treatment
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The holographical parameters of bistable reversible Al-VO/sub 2/-D media are investigated. The application of this media in coherent-optical image treatment devices is described.

articleTitle: The operational system of measurement device of laser radiation energy distribution
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The structural scheme of a laser radiation energy distribution measurement device is described. It consists of a measurement block, adjustable measurement device, and PC type computer. The Borland C++ Builder 4.0 visual programming system is chosen as the programming media. The system provides a color coded representation of the energy distribution within the laser beam.

articleTitle: Radiation impedance design of magnetostatic wave microstrip transducer
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The results of the radiation impedance design of a magnetostatic wave microstrip transducer are presented in this report. The radiation impedance was analysed as a function of frequency for microstrip lines with different distances between the line conductors and the surface of the magnetized ferrite film.

articleTitle: The automated system to research electrodynamical characteristic of microwave device by a resonant perturbation method
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Here are results of development of automated computer system intended to research electrodynamical characteristic of microwave-devices, using vector analyzer P4-36 and IBM PC, based on small resonant method. Usage of phase locking to resonance frequencies of object being investigated made possible higher precision and automation of field distribution measure process.

articleTitle: Theoretical and experimental study of the intensive high-convergence electron beams current-transmission
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Theoretical and experimental study of the intensive high-convergence electron beams current-transmission through the small cross-section channels has been conducted. It was demonstrated a conformity of the theoretical and experimental results.

articleTitle: Calculation of the field uniformly magnetized autonomous sources on the basis of the solution magnetostatic equations Maxwell in space of generalized functions
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The definition possibility of an analytic model of uniformly magnetized permanent magnets of different geometric shapes, based on magnetostatic Maxwell equations calculations using the superposition principle, is viewed.

articleTitle: P-L method of verification. Decoding of outcomes control
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This article describes the P-L method of digital device control. It details localization methods and control results fault decoding.

articleTitle: Simulation of non stationary electromagnetic fields with harmonic dependence from one of space coordinates
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: An algorithm for simulation of electromagnetic fields having harmonic dependence from one of space coordinates in the time domain is presented. The algorithm eliminates harmonic functional dependence from Maxwell's equations and reduces the problem dimensionless from 3 to 2. An algorithm is realized in computer code TREMSI. An example of the propagation constant calculation in a rectangular waveguide near its cutoff frequency is presented.

articleTitle: Particular solution of the problem of propagation of the axisymmetric spherical electromagnetic waves in isotropic space
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The solution of the problem of propagation of the spherical converging and diverging electromagnetic waves, and also of the standing spherical electromagnetic waves in the special situations, when in line with the polar axis of a spherical coordinate system is present either the ideally conducting filament, or system of the two cone ideally conducting surfaces with integrated vertexes, is obtained. The situations differ also by the representations about closure and breaking of these structural elements at centre.

articleTitle: Evolution of processes of generations noiselike oscillations in the systems contained two or more virtual cathodes
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The results of the experimental researchers in the case of forming two or more virtual cathodes are present. The experimental simulation dynamics of parameters which changes reproduce same secondary virtual cathodes by breaking electric fields and behaviors promoting stochastizations oscillations are reduced.

articleTitle: Warning system of segments faults in cable lines 6 kV
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A new type of system has been developed which represents a combination of devices reading instantaneous values of currents and pressure voltages, in checkpoints. All the gathered data is transferred on the same power cable, on a high frequency, in a core of the system.

articleTitle: P-L method of verification. Troubleshooting
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This article describes the P-L method of fault finding and a method for the formation of automatic fault finding using diagnostic data.

articleTitle: Microwave device on square waveguide
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Microwave device which contains a square cross section shaped waveguide as a basic unit of travelling wave applicator with two dominant modes H/sub 10/ and H/sub 01/ excited with the help of the sequence of stub waveguiding bifurcations located at adjacent waveguide walls is considered. Experiment confirms efficiency of electromagnetic wave interaction with processed material and possibility of employing given design in high temperature mode.

articleTitle: Agree with ownership analytical theory take power away from clystrode
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Considered interaction cut off impulses high-frequency current with fields resonator. Determine the first harmonic of beam, then put and solve equation of motion, and find the velocity of electrons. After this velocity to average on angle of flight electrons and on angle cut impulse of current. This average-velocity is a first equation of system. Second equation is a coefficient of efficiency combine with on an average velocity. The third equation is finding from determination coefficient efficiency with help potential acceleration and cut current through resonators. Solution this equation head to the electron-efficiency of clystrode. In optimal construction (cut is a half-wave, potential of grid and resonators - is equally), electron coefficient efficiency will maximum 0,547. But real efficiency will be in /spl pi/-time less. This so, because in /spl pi/-time less a current through a resonators of clystrode in comparison with equivalent to, that has equal current emission from cathode.

articleTitle: Phase detecting supershort microwave pulses
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The mathematical model of the double balanced phase detector of supershort microwave pulses is offered on the basis of a slot-hole line, the dependences of factors of transfer, distortions and temporary shift from parameters of the detector are investigated. The optimum significances of parameters are determined, at which distortion of a target signal are minimum.

articleTitle: Oscillations of surface acoustic Rayleigh wave transmission on Ga, Sc-substituted yttrium iron garnet films
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Resonant interaction between surface acoustic Rayleigh wave and backward volume magnetostatic wave on Ga, Sc-substituted yttrium iron garnet films was experimental studied. For the first time, an oscillation of SAW parameters caused by resonant interaction with backward volume magnetostatic wave modes of several numbers was observed.

articleTitle: Band properties of the horseshoe-shaped waveguide with partial dielectric filling
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The horseshoe-shaped waveguide falls into to the class of pseudo-steady waveguides and represents the /spl Pi/-waveguide with the rounded capacitive gap. He can successfully be used in engineering and power engineering of a very high frequency as a master cell of building bag of a very high frequency of heating plants.

articleTitle: Features of activity transistors in a structure of a very high frequency of generators with an external feedback
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Analysis of electric regimes of transistors in composition of SHF generations with external back connection and of limitations on values of parameters, which characterize these regime. Basis of necessity of insert loosing elements in back connection of these generations.

articleTitle: The combine way of account of MFS with permanent magnets
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This paper describes methods to account for magnetic fields in systems with multiple magnets and long magnetic channels. A combined method to account for the MFS (magnetic field strength) of permanent magnets is also described.

articleTitle: The wave impedance of grove-strip line
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The closed formula for wave impedance of grove-strip line has been derived and presented.

articleTitle: Nonmutual coupled ferrite transmission lines
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Simple expressions for calculation of nonmutual coupling coefficient and transition attenuation for the system consisted of two coupled microstrip transmission lines on common ferrite substrate, and besides on the lines operates in an edge wave mode, are obtained. Experimental pilot device is described, experimental and calculated dependencies of transition attenuation versus edge wave line width are represented.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of complex dynamics of chaotic self-oscillator
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This report presents the results of experimental investigation of a delayed feedback klystron oscillator in the regimes of single-frequency, self-modulation and chaotic oscillations and of the experimental study of the external harmonic signal influence on the complex dynamics of the oscillator. Experimental researches were carried out on an S-band five-cavity klystron of medium power level with double-gap cavities operating on the /spl pi/-mode.

articleTitle: The issues of creating the means for functional diagnostics of electrical machines
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The authors consider the issues of designing the automated means for functional diagnostics of electrical machines. The necessity of measuring the total complex of diagnostic parameters with help of electromagnetic sensors is proved.

articleTitle: Creation test tasks of various forms on the basis of complex(difficult) compositions of matrix type
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The material given in this work show various opportunities for the formation of test tasks on the basis of matrix type tasks. The main problem (task) in the processing of matrix type test tasks is the reception of a necessary degree of autonomy of elements in both sets and a high degree of conformity of one set of elements to another. Test tasks for conformity (matrix tasks) are necessary for considering (examining) the generalized model of the test task.

articleTitle: Analysis of nonlinear distortions the single-tones and two-tones signals in MESFET
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The calculation of output spectrum the MESFET amplifier at affect of single-wavelength and double-frequency tests-signals is adduced. Calculation is realized with usage of 7-th order MESFET model. Values of amplitudes the discrete components are defined with the count and without the count of self-heating effect.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of thin-film electroluminescent light sources characteristics
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Mathematical modeling problems are considered for the electrical and electrooptical characteristics of thin-film electroluminescent AC-driven light emitters. Mathematical models of light elements and devices are created on the basis of the electron processes in the thin-films, followed by a description of the control schemes electrical characteristics.

articleTitle: Scanning of laser radiation by decreasing cross-section current in narrow-zone semiconductors
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In work process of scanning of laser radiation of the IK-range is investigated at temperature-electric instability narrow-zone the semiconductor n-InSb. During an experimental research the good coordination with theoretical conclusions that allows to use effect temperature-electric instability for creation highly effective deflector and scanners laser radiation with interval about 10,6-10,9 minute width is received.

articleTitle: Computer support of measurements at use of test technologies at the rate "devices of the microwave"
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this work are reflected the questions connected with the use of test technologies for estimating the level of preparedness of students in a determined discipline. This is on the basis of parallel test formation using separate computer generated test tasks.

articleTitle: The controlling negative dispersion of helical slow-wave structure
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The possibility of controlling negative dispersion of helical slow-wave structure by choosing of its components geometry is shown in the article. The influence of dielectric permittivity on the per unit length of inductance and capacity of equivalent long line is considered.

articleTitle: Light-stimulated ionic etching of semiconductor heterostructures
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: For study of impurities distribution in film hetero-phase photoresistors the method of the secondary ionic mass-spectrometry was used. Influence of illumination by visible light on an output of ions of cadmium and lead is revealed. It being found that the output of cadmium ions at illumination decreases, but lead ions increases. The increase of an output of lead ions contacts to that lead contains mainly in the narrow-gap sites of the photoconductor being a drain of photoexcited electron-hole pairs.

articleTitle: Interconversion of the functional block descriptions and their implementation in VHDL-AMS
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this work the approach for automatic creation of functional block models is presented. The main methods of device description at functional level are considered and the possible ways of their interconversion are pointed. It is shown the possibility of presentation such descriptions in terms of the hardware description language VHDL-AMS targeted for analog and mixed-signal devices. The comparison of simulation results for models in VHDL-AMS and equivalent SPICE-model is presented.

articleTitle: Layered thin-film magnetic structures as a basis of spintronic element base
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The technology and diagnostics of thin film magnetic structures are reported, in the context of investigations of spin-dependent electron transport effects, for use in the design of magnetic storage devices. The achieved parameters are reported and discussed.

articleTitle: The analysis of losses influence on the characteristics of the helical slow-wave structure
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This article is devoted to the problem of the influence of different kinds of losses on the attenuation and wave slowing in the helical slow-wave structure of TWTs. The equivalent circuit of a helical SWS, and calculations of its distributed parameters, corresponding to different physical regions, are proposed. In this article, the frequency dependences of attenuation and slowing of electromagnetic waves are also given.

articleTitle: Defect formation and transport processes on surface of the semiconductor at electrodegradation of a system the metal-semiconductor
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The defect formation activity in a system consisting of a semiconductor wafer and a thin metallic film is passing single-pulses of a current of density j=(1...8)*10/sup 10/ A/m and duration /spl tau/=50...800 ms throught it.

articleTitle: Microelectromechanical system based on a composite as analog of structure with phase change metal-dielectric
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In sectional operation the basic attention is given to clearing up of dependences between an acting voltage and change of properties of an aggregate in field before failure of system, in which the realization both continuous, and jump changes of properties is possible. This field is of interest for those applications in an electronics, in which the hysteresis of properties and storage of action is not necessary.

articleTitle: The mathematical simulation of helical slow-wave structure with the inhomogeneous by azimuth shield
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A method of mathematical simulation of helical slow-wave structures with inhomogeneous (by azimuth) shields and with dielectric filling of the space between helix and shield is suggested in this work. The method is based on the idea of the helix in the aspect of an equivalent long line. Parameters of the line are determined by summation of partial parameters of homogeneous sectors of transverse cross-section of the SWS. A design program for the helical slow-wave structure SWSM2.0 is proposed. The dispersion characteristics calculated by this program, and those received experimently, are both analyzed. The influence of screening constants of electric and magnetic fields on the dispersion characteristics is also investigated.

articleTitle: About nature of "mirror" spurious oscillation in spectrum of magnetron devices with central by the cathode
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The experimental findings of an investigation of the nature and ways of suppressing "mirror"-type spurious oscillation of potent magnetron devices, observed on the output of an M-type device, is adduced at their docking with instrumentation power sources. The problem has a general enough nature, and is practically foregone in mining instrumentation operating magnetron sources of a very high frequency and power, and is directly connected to a heightened noise level in magnetron devices.

articleTitle: The "point" potential distribution research with use of the measuring computer system
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The measuring computer system (MCS) have been designed and created for noncontact nondestructive measurement of potential and charge surface distributions. Special potential "point" tests have been designed and created for determination of MCS space resolution and sensitivity. Experimental results of test potential distribution research are considered.

articleTitle: Mathematical modelling of work regimes of cathode with net clusters in multi-beam klystrode
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In the given activity the interface of the program of calculation of electron guns with fine-mesh control grids used in a VHF devices with net control is described. The results of calculation electron gun for multi-beam klystrode are given.

articleTitle: About modulation gear of abnormal noise in devices of M-type with the central cathode
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: On the basis of experimental research, the authors have drawn a conclusion about modulation equipment for heightened noise in magnetron type devices. This gear is conditioned by broadband noise self-excitation of an electronic flow in a VHF range and modulation by this noise of a working signal of a very high frequency range.

articleTitle: Pretreatment of the photomaps
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Within the framework of the given method here, single photographs are not selected for individual treatment from the set or packet of photographs. The essence of this method is instead reduced to construction of some "average" photograph, the intensity of each pixel of which is the arithmetic mean of intensities of the conforming points of the entire set of photographs. Thus, there is an increase in the signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: The microprocessor system of control by electric motors in apparatus of air cooling of oil in the aggregate of gas compression
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Microprocessor system control is a valuable technique for the control of electric motors. An application of this technique has been used in apparatus for the air-cooling of oil, in the field of gas compression. This system of control has led to savings in electrical energy usage.

articleTitle: Features of usage of different modes in circular cavities for exaltation of a microwave discharge in electrodeless lamps
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The outcomes of calculations of strengths of electrical fields in a circular cavity on H/sub 111/, H/sub 011/ and E/sub 010/ modes are given. The features of their usage are discussed in terms of the exaltation of light discharge in electrodeless lamps.

articleTitle: The probabilistic model of the smear blood for the interpretation of the Weiner spectrum of fluctuations of passage coefficient of the light
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Various variants have been worked out of a probabilistic model of the smear blood consisting of one type of form elements - erythrocytes. This model binds the parameters of the elements with the Weiner spectrum of fluctuations of passage coefficient of the light flow through a blood smear.

articleTitle: Magnetostatic surface wave nondispersive delay line
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The experimental study of a magnetostatic surface wave delay line is presented. The delay line is designed by adopting the simple layered structure of an yttrium iron garnet (YIG) chip, placed on two matched microstrips evaporated on a metallized dielectric substrate. A region of constant delay of 125/spl plusmn/13 ns is obtained over a region 2.8% wide at center frequency. The minimum insertion loss of the nondispersive delay line is of the order of 21 dB.

articleTitle: Interaction of microstrip resonator with the ferromagnetic film at the magnetostatic wave excitation
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The experimental research of the "half-wave microstrip resonator - YIG film" systems characteristics at the various types of MSW excitation is carried out. It shows that the investigated system represents the system of two coupled oscillatory circuits the properties of which depend on the value and direction of the external bias field.

articleTitle: The application of Al-VO2-D media for optical radiation visualisation
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The Al-VO/sub 2/-D media optical technical parameters are investigated, as well as the exposial sensitiveness and resolution for visualisation of impulses with wavelengths of 0.3-10.6 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: A code for analysis and optimization of resonator slow wave systems with selective absorbers
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: An algorithm for analysis and optimization of coupled cavity chains containing selective absorbers is described. The algorithm is based on the partial regions method and calculates dispersion, interaction impedance and attenuation constants in cavity and slot passbands and neighboring stopbands. Selective absorbers are considered as dielectric resonators excited by the cavity field. The optimization is performed by Monte-Carlo and modified Newton methods. The results of analysis and optimization are presented.

articleTitle: Axisymmetric standing spherical electromagnetic waves in isotropic space with a "core" at the centre
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The solution of a problem of the standing spherical electromagnetic waves in space, free from sources, in case of isotropic medium on assumption of rotational symmetry, at presence of ideally conducting spherical "core" at the centre is offered. Analytical expressions for components of fields of the symmetric standing spherical E- and H-waves at presence of "core" at the centre are obtained.

articleTitle: Electron-optical system for high power millimeter wave source
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The results designing and experimental investigation electron-optical system (EOS) for high power millimeter wave source are presented. This EOS operating at a beam voltage of 18-19 kV and a beam current of 0,5-0,55 A provide the beam forming and transporting with beam transmission of 99% and more through the transmission channel with a diameter of 0,48 mm and a length of 25 mm.

articleTitle: Synthesis of electron guns on focusing of electron beams by periodic magnetic field
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The synthesis of electron guns on focusing of electron beams by periodic magnetic field has been considered. Calculation results of guns are presented.

articleTitle: Research influencing of instability a supply voltage on operation the industrial equipment of microwave drying
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Research has been carried out on large supply voltage instability influence on the functioning efficiency of microwave drying equipment, including all its units and assemblies. It has been determined that a 15-20% increase or decrease from the nominal value has little practical influence on the microwave drying equipment functioning and technical/economic parameters. However, its increase leads to accelerated wear and a decrease in reliability and operating life. It has been shown that the microwave drying equipment internal magnetron generators can be protected from circuit supply voltage increases by the use of input resistor block sections.

articleTitle: P-L method of verification. Conditional decoding
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This article presents the possibility of using the P-L method for fault localization. The P-L method of conditional decoding is described. A simple combination scheme is outlined along with P-L tests and diagnostic data.

articleTitle: Computation of cutoff wavelength of dominant mode of hexagonal waveguide
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Technique of cutoff wavelength calculation of dominant mode of equilateral hexagonal waveguide (HW), based on similarity of fields of H/sub 11/-mode in circular waveguide and analyzed one is considered. Analytical expressions for computation of cutoff wavelength of dominant mode of equilateral HW and comparison of results obtained using described method with known data are represented.

articleTitle: About an opportunity of creation of the hybrid multi modular multi beam device - the source of microwave pulses with gigawatt power
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The project of new compact effective device - the source of microwave pulses with gigawatt power is considered. The device is based on multi beam multi module technology. The resotrod (novel HF amplifier or generator) is proved to be a power supply for the device proposed. The absence of large and heavy blocks (such as high voltage supplies) allows to manufacture a compact mobile device, which can be placed on the auto platform or on the airplane.

articleTitle: Features distribution of supershort pulses in passive elements of a microwave trakt
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The theoretical researches of features of passage of supershort radiopulses (SSP) through the adder and divider of a microwave of capacity are conducted. The influence of parameters of the given system on the spectral characteristics and temporary form SSP is determined. The dependences of easing of capacity and normalized factor of distortions from parameters of the adder and divider are constructed.

articleTitle: Experimental researches of transit a high frequency signal in cable lines 6 kV
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Sensings of the per unit length coefficient of self-induction and capacitance of a high-voltage cable, of cross-section 150 mm/sup 2/ and length 2600 m, between distributive points of an electrical circuit, were conducted. An experimental check of the transit of a high frequency signal on a pigtail of length 3000 m, between two distribution stations was carried out.

articleTitle: Thermal and mechanical way of obtaining dry timber in an electromagnetic field of a very high frequency
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Is offered and is experimentally investigated thermal and mechanical way of obtaining of dry timber. It is process mating an evaporation from a volume of an arboreal sample on its surface of a moisture under effect of a field of a very high frequency and subsequent cutting off the surface layer, keeping a moisture. Thus the drying is eliminated and is reduced costs of time and energy to obtaining of dry timber from 4 up to 6 times.

articleTitle: Complex cross section shaped waveguides parameters optimization
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Optimized parameters: broadbandness and filling coefficient of hollow rectangular T-septum waveguide are defined using numerical modelling results and goal function minimization. Described technique may be employed for optimization of different electromagnetic parameters of various complex cross section shaped waveguides.

articleTitle: Near-resonance self-action in amplitude modulated laser beams
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Numerical modeling of self-action of a beam, whose amplitude is periodically modulated in time, in a two-level saturable absorbing medium is reported. For describe a beam self-action we solve numerically the full set of Maxwell-Bloch equations. We study the influence of the non-stationary self-action of the beam on the transmission of modulation signal through the medium. It is shown that in the time dependence of the polarization and population difference the nonlinear distortions of the modulation signal can be much stronger than in the output field intensity.

articleTitle: The check of quality of radial magnetised sectoral magnets
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The methods of testing sector magnets, ensuring control of an even magnetization, are described. The methods are suitable for use in MFS and electric motors.

articleTitle: About method of ultrashort or short UHF impulses generation
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: It's paper about the method of ultrashort or short UHF impulses generation. This impulses may having following parameters: main frequency near 10 GHz; long of impulse - 300 ps - 3 ns; impulse period / long impulse Q = 2... 10; pulses power - 50-150 kW.

articleTitle: The analysis and synthesis of acoustoelectronic's devices on the basis of variational methods
publicationTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The variational methods for the analysis and synthesis of the acoustoelectronic devices are suggested. The analysis methods permits to simplify sufficiently the boundary condition for arbitrary configuration and to construct bilinear functionals, in which stationary value can be easily made equal to any required parameter of the initial problem. The synthesis methods are constructed on the basis of quadratic functionals, which include bilinear functionals of devices parameters analysis.

articleTitle: Fifth International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE'2002) (IEEE Cat. No.02EX577)
